desc: Count the frequency of each character in the string s.
Sort the frequencies in descending order to easily pick the top m characters.
Iterate over all possible target frequencies k from 1 to len(s).
For each k, iterate over the number of characters m to include (from 1 to 26, or the number of distinct characters).
For each (k, m) pair, calculate the cost: sum of deletions for excluded characters, plus max(total_surplus, total_deficit) for included characters.
Track the minimum cost across all (k, m) pairs and return it.
Implement the solution by counting character frequencies, sorting them, and iterating over all possible target frequencies k and number of characters m to calculate the minimum operations.
